connector.name: MCP by htmldrop.app
connector.registryDescription: Publish HTML or Markdown from any MCP client to a live, shareable URL on htmldrop.app.
connector.summary: Hosted at htmldrop.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace app.htmldrop, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: HTMLDROP_API_TOKEN
env.description: htmldrop API token (hsk_live_…). Create one at https://htmldrop.app/dashboard/settings → API tokens.

env.name: HTMLDROP_API_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL. Leave unset to use htmldrop.app's hosted API; set only for self-hosted or staging deployments.
